prompt_en: A contemporary Japanese summer fashion photograph beside a sunlit beach, showing two unmistakably adult Japanese people in their mid-twenties dressed in coordinated adult swimwear. The confident, deeply tanned man has bleached golden-blond hair, a patterned open resort shirt over black trunks, a gold chain, and a teasing grin. He performs a clear kabedon, his right palm planted flat on the beach-club wall beside the woman's head as he leans close. The adult woman is a reserved literature graduate student in a navy one-piece swimsuit and light linen cover-up, holding an open paperback against her chest. She meets the same man's gaze with a level, cool expression, then quietly straightens his wind-lifted collar with her free hand. Her cool composure cracks into a warm blush across her ears; her thumb loses its page and several pages flutter, the visible consequence of his sudden closeness. Frame a vertical waist-up two-shot at eye level; use the braced forearm as a diagonal. Warm late-afternoon rim light and soft open shade keep both adult faces, hands, paperback, gesture, and playful romantic tension immediately legible.
